lines.text: Every day, buyers walk onto your floor.
They have seen the car. They have agreed the price.
Then comes the question. How will I pay?
When the finance is not there, the sale walks out of the door.
Owners told us: for every ten cars they sell, about four more ready buyers leave without one.
AutoLink brings financing to your floor.
Your team submits the buyer's request in the AutoLink dealer portal, and follows it, step by step.
Requests, reports and your account, in one dashboard.
In Arabic, in English, or in Chinese.
And behind every request stand Saudi Arabia's leading banks and finance companies, partnering with AutoLink.
And we train your sales team. On the portal, and on the conversation with the buyer.
Next on our roadmap: every buyer matched to the right lender, for faster approvals.
Then your stock online, and new buyers sent to your door.
Twenty showrooms have already signed. Yours could be next.
AutoLink. Every buyer on your floor, a buyer you can finance.
